action_summary: Preserved the checkpoint, Kaggle input paths, NER/math preprocessing and mean fold ensemble. Restored target-wise ordinal discretization using five equal-width bins fitted to each prediction column, normalized to [0,1], with continuous fallbacks for collapsed or effectively constant columns. This is an explicit new binning configuration, motivated by the stronger discretized historical versions; the history does not establish a causal gain or reveal their exact parameters. Added prediction shape/finite checks and a separate raw submission for comparison; submission.csv contains the discretized predictions. No training or inference was run, so a leaderboard improvement remains unverified.
